question: What recitation expiates the unintentional eating of forbidden nirmālya?
premises: An alternative case concerns eating without desire or intent.
In that case one should perform recitation.
The prescribed recitation is the brahmapañcaka.
inference: Unintentional eating of nirmālya is expiated by reciting the brahmapañcaka.
uncertainties: The exact content of the brahmapañcaka is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Or, if one eats nirmālya unintentionally, one should recite the brahmapañcaka.
